instruction.name: xvperm.w
instruction.description: Permute 32-bit elements of two LASX registers.

latencies.notes: vj -> vd; consecutive unrolled copies form a chain. Raw measurement was 3.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvperm.w $xr0, $xr8, $xr16; xvperm.w $xr1, $xr9, $xr17; xvperm.w $xr2, $xr10, $xr18; xvperm.w $xr3, $xr11, $xr19; xvperm.w $xr4, $xr12, $xr20; xvperm.w $xr5, $xr13, $xr21; xvperm.w $xr6, $xr14, $xr22; xvperm.w $xr7, $xr15, $xr23
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x0102030405060708; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr1, $r4; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr2, $r4' --asm 'xvperm.w $xr0, $xr8, $xr16; xvperm.w $xr1, $xr9, $xr17; xvperm.w $xr2, $xr10, $xr18; xvperm.w $xr3, $xr11, $xr19; xvperm.w $xr4, $xr12, $xr20; xvperm.w $xr5, $xr13, $xr21; xvperm.w $xr6, $xr14, $xr22; xvperm.w $xr7, $xr15, $xr23'
